description: This file is a PHP source code for a web UI page that manages WAN network settings, including Ethernet and DOCSIS modes, IP addresses, and operational modes. It includes server-side logic for retrieving network info, access control based on user role, and client-side Javascript for interactive UI elements and AJAX calls to update configuration.

methods.name: changeAutoWanMode
methods.description: Triggers a confirmation prompt and saves the selected WAN mode (Ethernet or DOCSIS) via AJAX if confirmed.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the WAN network configuration by making an AJAX POST request to the backend PHP script.

methods.name: changeMode
methods.description: Sends an AJAX request to update the WAN network mode and reloads the page upon success.
